newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid weak sentiment.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended down amid a lingering bearish trend caused by lack of market-moving news and selling pressure by small investors trying to escape from a falling market, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index lost 7.9 points or 0.81 percent to 956.07 on turnover of 39.8 million taka on Monday. Losers led gainers by 93 to 39.

"The small investors are wary about the future of the market. There is not enough institutional support to prevent the slide," said broker Khurshid Alam. Bangladesh Lamps lost 96 taka to 4,236 and Chittagong Cement shed 61 to 1,554.
